info.name: Speechmatics Batch Transcription API Keys Jobs API

description.content:
The Speechmatics Automatic Speech Recognition REST API is used to submit ASR jobs and receive the results. The supported job type is transcription of audio files. Supports 55+ languages, speaker diarization, translation, summarization, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and custom vocabulary.

Contact Support:
 Email: support@speechmatics.com
